reviewType: Unblinded post-test visual and histogram review; six failed-image sheets and three correct-control sheets inspected. No blind-labeling claim.
important: These are proposed review findings and a same-rule diagnostic. Original ledgers, frozen splits, thresholds, model and original reported metrics remain unchanged. Correctly recognized controls receive the same visual scrutiny.
